posts.title: Baltimore’s Crime Drop
posts.description: If you are reading this, no doubt you already know Baltimore has seen an amazing reduction in violence. This started in 2022 and continues into September 2026. There were 333 murders in 2022 and 133 last year. There have been 75 murders year-to-date in 2026 (As of Sep 8). Why? Well, some combination of everything:… Read more

posts.title: Baltimore’s Turn
posts.description: When I went to Baltimore in 1999 and became a cop, I thought my first book was going to be about Baltimore’s Great Crime Drop. A national “trend” and all.
